verdict.rationale: e-FRRO stores users' personal registration data, so data-residency choice is a fair privacy question rather than a category error. The evidence pack contains only front-door probes (a script-only root page and a 404 on a legacy entry path), and nothing about where data is stored or whether users can pick a region.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can choose where my data is stored (region/residency)
